name: ternimal
description: Work on your own hosts through tern mcp: policy-bound commands, file transfers, background jobs and interactive terminals over end-to-end TLS, with approval prompts, redaction and an audit log.

config.title: tern mcp config file
config.description: Path to the JSON file that names your hosts and their policy profiles. A leading ~/ is expanded. The ternimal:setup skill helps you write it.
